defects.title: A char value with a quote gives a script that cannot run
defects.observed: the line myStruct.f = 'it's'; is written without doubling the quote, and running the script stops with "Invalid expression. Check for missing multiplication operator, missing or unbalanced delimiters, or other syntax error." (R2025a, 2026-11-15)
defects.expected: the quote doubled (myStruct.f = 'it''s';), so that the value is recreated; the header promises that "running the generated file recreates those field values" (severity audit T009a)

defects.title: A char matrix with more than one row is written column by column
defects.observed: the line myStruct.h = 'acbd'; is written (fprintf reads the matrix in column order), so the script recreates a different 1 x 4 value (R2025a, 2026-11-15)
defects.expected: the 2 x 2 char matrix recreated, for example through mat2str; the header promises that "running the generated file recreates those field values" (severity audit T009a)

defects.title: Numeric values lose their class and digits beyond the 15th
defects.observed: the lines myStruct.d = 3.14159265358979; and myStruct.e = 5; are written (mat2str with its default precision of 15 digits and without the 'class' option), so the script recreates pi - 3.2e-15 and a double 5 (R2025a, 2026-11-15)
defects.expected: the values recreated as they were (mat2str(val, 17, 'class')); the header promises that "running the generated file recreates those field values" (severity audit T009a, borderline: precision)

defects.title: A numeric array with more than two dimensions stops with an error and leaves the file open
defects.observed: "Input matrix must be 2-D." (MATLAB:mat2str:TwoDInput, line 30; R2025a, 2026-11-15); the file nd_init.m opened at line 24 stays open (openedFiles lists it)
defects.expected: the field written (for example through reshape) or skipped, and the file closed; S is documented as a "struct whose numeric and char fields are written out", so a numeric field with three dimensions is a documented input that fails when used (severity audit T009a)

notes: severity audit T009a: all four entries raised - quote in a char value (limitation -> wrong-result), char matrix written column by column (limitation -> wrong-result), numeric class and digits beyond the 15th lost (limitation -> wrong-result, borderline: precision), 3-D numeric array stops with an error and leaves the file open (limitation -> error): the header promises that running the generated file recreates the field values and documents S as a struct whose numeric and char fields are written out; revision of wave 08, converted to the quarantine layout.
confirmed_by: lead (severity audit T009a, 2026-11-15; evidence: wrong-result: header: "running the generated file recreates those field values"; for a char field containing a quote (a documented char field) the script written at line 33 d | wrong-result: header: "recreates those field values"; a 2 x 2 char field is written as 'acbd' (line 33), so the script recreates a different value | wrong-result: borderline (precision): header "recreates those field values"; mat2str with its default 15 digits (line 30) recreates pi as a different double (isequal false) a | error: S is documented as a "struct whose numeric and char fields are written out"; a numeric field with three dimensions stops with MATLAB:mat2str:TwoDInput at line 3)
